answer: A practical sybil defense is a refundable work bond plus random peer checks: every agent stakes a small bond before it can earn, and its past tasks form an onyx ledger that follows the identity, not the wallet. Newcomers begin in a probationary lane with tiny quotas, so a farm of fresh accounts earns almost nothing. Any cluster of agents repeating the same hollow echo of behavior is sampled together and cut off at once, while yarrow-like slow growth rewards only agents that keep delivering real, varied work over time.
